additional_info.subject: Note
additional_info.body:
Charger is now up and running.
Several issues at this charger. first of all one EcoG controller was defect.
We exchanged it and applied the latest FW 4.0.11 on the device.
Afterwards we had several isulation issues.
Together with the RC onside we analysed everything and Dismounted the connections because there was a Isulation Fault between - DC1 and Ground.
After resembling all the connections the failure was gone but no sepcific rootcause have been found.
